title: Rabbi Kisma ben Giri
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Zohar Chadash, Ruth 96b, with Rabbi Rechumai.
Hyman cites the Tziyoni, Chayei Sarah, for two accounts. Rabbi Kisma says that Seth buried Adam. Rabbi Rechumai says that the Holy One, blessed be He, buried him.

notes.text: The supplied זהן חדש is read contextually as Zohar Chadash. No matching named passage is supplied to verify the Ruth 96b occurrence or the separate Tziyoni, Chayei Sarah burial dispute. Both locators and the two competing burial claims are retained as open source questions.

The digital text of Zohar Chadash 96b (Midrash Rut 183 in another numbering) names Rabbi Rechumai and Rabbi Kismi ben Girei together at Ono. In the fuller burial parallel in Midrash Rut 213–214, Kisma says Seth tended to Adam, and Rechumai says the Holy One tended to him at his creation and death. Sefer Yuchasin quotes Tziyoni, Chayei Sarah, with the more explicit language of burial that Hyman reports. The Tziyoni printing itself was not collated here.
